title: Horseshoe morphism lift with exact augmented source complexes
statement: Let $\mathcal B$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian]. Let $0\to A\to B\to C\to0$ and $0\to A'\to B'\to C'\to0$ be short exact sequences. Suppose $X_A^\bullet$, $X_B^\bullet$, and $X_C^\bullet$ have augmentations $A\to X_A^0$, $B\to X_B^0$, and $C\to X_C^0$ and are exact in the augmented sequences $0\to A\to X_A^0\to X_A^1\to\cdots$, $0\to B\to X_B^0\to X_B^1\to\cdots$, and $0\to C\to X_C^0\to X_C^1\to\cdots$, respectively. Assume they form a short exact sequence of complexes $0\to X_A^\bullet\to X_B^\bullet\to X_C^\bullet\to0$ compatible with the augmentations. Suppose the primed sequence is equipped with a horseshoe resolution by injective resolutions as in [lem-weil-pbc-horseshoe-morphism-lift]. Given a morphism $(a,b,c)$ of the two short exact sequences and endpoint complex maps $\varphi_A:X_A^\bullet\to I_{A'}'^\bullet$ and $\varphi_C:X_C^\bullet\to I_{C'}'^\bullet$ compatible with the augmentations, there is a complex map $\varphi_B:X_B^\bullet\to I_{B'}'^\bullet$ compatible with the augmentation and with both short exact sequence maps. The source complexes need only satisfy the displayed exact augmented sequences; they need not be injective resolutions.

source.place: Lemma Tag 015I, comparison morphism construction; the target horseshoe rows split degreewise and the source rows require only exactness

proof.text: Write the source rows as $0\to X_A^n\xrightarrow{i^n}X_B^n\xrightarrow{p^n}X_C^n\to0$, with augmentations $s_A,s_B,s_C$ and $f:A\to B$, $g:B\to C$. In every degree the target horseshoe row $0\to I_{A'}'^n\xrightarrow{\alpha'^n}I_{B'}'^n\xrightarrow{\beta'^n}I_{C'}'^n\to0$ splits by [lem-weil-pbc-ses-injective-kernel-splits], since $I_{A'}'^n$ is injective; let $\sigma'^n$ be a section of $\beta'^n$. Extend $\varphi_A^n$ along the monomorphism $i^n$ to $t^n:X_B^n\to I_{A'}'^n$ with $t^n i^n=\varphi_A^n$, by the defining extension property of injective objects [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Set $\chi^n=\alpha'^n t^n+\sigma'^n\varphi_C^n p^n$. Then $\chi^n i^n=\alpha'^n\varphi_A^n$ and $\beta'^n\chi^n=\varphi_C^n p^n$ for every $n$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 015I, comparison morphism construction; degreewise extension into injective target terms

proof.text: Let $D^n=d\chi^n-\chi^{n+1}d:X_B^n\to I_{B'}'^{n+1}$ be the differential defect of $\chi$. Since $\varphi_A,\varphi_C$ are complex maps, $D^n i^n=\alpha'(d\varphi_A-\varphi_A d)=0$ and $\beta' D^n=(d\varphi_C-\varphi_C d)p=0$. As $\alpha'^{n+1}$ is a kernel of $\beta'^{n+1}$ and $p^n$ is a cokernel of $i^n$ [def-sp-abelian], there are unique $E^n:X_C^n\to I_{A'}'^{n+1}$ with $D^n=\alpha'E^np^n$. From $D=d\chi-\chi d$ one gets $dD=-d\chi d=-Dd$, so $\alpha'(dE+Ed)p=0$ and hence $dE^n+E^{n+1}d=0$. At degree zero the augmentation defect $w=\chi^0s_B-s'_{B'}b:B\to I_{B'}'^0$ satisfies $wf=\alpha'\varphi_A^0s_A-\alpha's'_{A'}a=0$ and $\beta'w=\varphi_C^0s_Cg-s'_{C'}g'b=0$, so likewise $w=\alpha'eg$ for a unique $e:C\to I_{A'}'^0$. Since $ds_B=0$ we get $dw=D^0s_B$, i.e. $\alpha'(de)g=\alpha'E^0s_Cg$, hence $E^0s_C=de$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 015I, comparison morphism construction; defect factorization through the outer source term

proof.text: Let $K^\bullet$ be $X_C^\bullet$ with $C$ adjoined in degree $-1$ via $s_C$; the exact augmented sequence of the statement says $K^\bullet$ is acyclic. Let $T^\bullet$ be the complex with $T^m=I_{A'}'^{m+1}$ and differential $d$; it is zero in degrees below $-1$ and has injective terms. The maps $u^{-1}=e$ and $u^n=(-1)^nE^n$ ($n\ge0$) form a morphism $u:K^\bullet\to T^\bullet$, by $dE^n=-E^{n+1}d$ and $E^0s_C=de$. By [lem-weil-pbc-acyclic-map-to-injective-nullhomotopy] there are $h^m:K^m\to T^{m-1}=I_{A'}'^m$ with $u^m=dh^m+h^{m+1}d$; here $h^{-1}=0$. Put $k^n=(-1)^nh^n:X_C^n\to I_{A'}'^n$. Then $e=k^0s_C$ and $E^n=dk^n-k^{n+1}d$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 013R, applied to the exact augmented source C-row and the shifted target injective complex

proof.text: Define $\varphi_B^n=\chi^n-\alpha'k^np^n$. Its differential defect is $D^n-\alpha'(dk^n-k^{n+1}d)p^n=D^n-\alpha'E^np^n=0$, so $\varphi_B$ is a complex map. Since $\beta'\alpha'=0$ and $p\,i=0$, still $\beta'\varphi_B=\varphi_Cp$ and $\varphi_Bi=\alpha'\varphi_A$. Finally $\varphi_B^0s_B-s'_{B'}b=w-\alpha'k^0p^0s_B=\alpha'(e-k^0s_C)g=0$, so $\varphi_B$ is compatible with the augmentations and with both short exact sequence maps.

source.place: Lemma Tag 015I, final correction of the middle map
